analysis: The only change is a documentation edit in docs/architecture/inference.md at line 1353 (base and head). It adds a note that gpt_oss bf16 checkpoints keep bf16 activations and native K/V on every layer, because the expert SwiGLU clamp takes scalar bounds in the activation dtype (GPTOSS+Experts.swift, swiglu). No security control, gate, endpoint or cache identity is described as changed. The existing text about historical complete checkpoints, the default-on gpt-oss-20b prefix cache and the observed dtype/capability gates is retained verbatim. I checked this against T-041 and SEC-035: SSD prefix-cache scope, TTL, HMAC naming and the kill switch are unaffected. The dtype note reinforces the paged KV dtype validation described at lines 1336-1345 rather than weakening it. The note concerns numerical behavior only; it does not touch A-001 confidentiality, attestation (TB-009/TB-011) or authorization. The rest of the unit text (lines 822-1621) is unchanged context. The underlying Swift change in GPTOSS+Experts.swift is not in this batch. Integration should verify, if that file is in the PR, that the dtype change does not alter the observed-dtype cache identity or layoutEpoch bindings (T-041 detection_hint). No regression was identified from this documentation unit.
